title: Readiness Signal source registry (pipeline/sources.json)
description: Public sources the pipeline collects from. Documentation only: validated in code by pipeline/lib/sources.mjs (unknown keys are warnings, not errors).

publication.description: Name shown as the source publication.

type.description: feed: RSS 2.0 / Atom / RSS 1.0 (RDF), auto-detected. cisa-kev: the CISA KEV catalogue JSON (one candidate per CVE added in the window, url = the CISA catalogue entry for that CVE; the collector's headline is marked headline_composed and is omitted from item sources). page: read manually by the agent, listed as 'manual' in fetch-report.json; add what is found with add-manual.mjs.

paywalled.description: Paywalled publications: headline and lead-level reference only; lead capped at 40 words.

lead_words.description: Words of description/summary kept as the lead. Paywalled sources: max 40.

tier.description: Optional, news sources only. general = general or business press; trade = trade or specialist press. Used for FILTER.md 2.7.4 prominence and the 2.9 source order (general before trade; within a tier, public before paywalled).

enabled.description: Optional. false skips the source without deleting it.

exclude_url_patterns.description: Optional. Entries whose link contains any of these substrings (case-insensitive) are skipped at fetch and counted as excluded, e.g. ["/event-info/"] for sponsored webinar listings. Event-listing URL segments are also dropped at stage 1 for every source (lexicon EVENT_URL_SEGMENTS).

prefilter.description: Optional stage-1 profile override (default by class: regulator/standards_body lenient; vendor_threat_research primary, or authority on a government CERT host such as cisa.gov or ncsc.gov.uk; news/industry_trade standard; research_analysis strict; arXiv/SSRN hosts high_volume).
